notes: Circle of fifths, now a practice tool: tap any key to hear its tonic, and start Circle Practice to let the metronome walk the whole app around the circle - the key advances every 1/2/4/8 bars (in fifths or fourths), strums the new tonic, and the fretboard follows so you can practice each key as it lands. Also fixes the fretboard jumping around during practice: auto-scroll no longer fights your fingers or itself.
